integrity.verification: two exhaustive standalone implementations and a full normalized finite census

scientific_limitations: Finite exact classification only for aperiodic binary spans six and seven; not a general-span theorem.
The cited prior preprint determines the maximum lengths, which are not claimed as novel.
The census and symmetry refinements lack independent external audit; unindexed historical enumeration data could overlap.
title: Complete aperiodic orientable-word spectra and extremal symmetry at binary spans six and seven
